copilot.name: AI Learning Copilot
copilot.subtitle: Online • Grounded in MoSPI curriculum
copilot.welcome:
Namaste! I'm your **AI Learning Copilot**.

Ask me anything about sampling, SQL, or data quality — every answer cites your curriculum, with timestamps. What shall we explore?
copilot.placeholder: Ask about sampling, SQL, weights, formulas…
copilot.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is supported in Chrome/Edge.
copilot.voiceError: Voice input failed. Please try again.
copilot.voiceErrorPermission: Microphone is blocked. Allow mic access in your browser's address-bar settings, then try again.
copilot.voiceErrorNoMic: No microphone found. Connect one and try again.
copilot.voiceErrorNetwork: Voice recognition needs an internet connection.
copilot.voiceErrorBusy: Mic is busy or still closing from the last try. Wait a moment, then try again.
copilot.disclaimer: Answers cite only approved curriculum. Levels and quiz answers are never revealed or changed.
copilot.errorWithRetry: I encountered an issue connecting to the AI service. The copilot works offline too — please retry, or reopen this lesson and ask again.
copilot.contextNone: No lesson pinned — the copilot searches all approved transcripts.
